description: The Pi v1.2.0 fixture set: each fixture, the suites that read its v1.1.0 counterpart today, and per scenario (a top-level key of an *.upstream.json, a session scenario directory, or a whole file) the work-list areas (compatibility/durable-sync-1.2.0-worklist.json) that switch their suites to it, and whether it matches the v1.1.0 capture under the manifest's normalization ("same": switch at any time; "differs": switch with the port that changes it; "new": no v1.1.0 counterpart, a new case to port; "metadata": the captured commit, not a case). The C# suites still read the v1.1.0 set; nothing here is read by a test yet. Written by tools/DurableFixtures/capture-all.mjs; regenerate, never edit by hand.
switching: An area moves a suite by pointing its fixture path at this set (for compat.*, CompatCases.Fixtures, which reads every session scenario from one directory, so it switches once every scenario it runs matches; tool-interrupted and subagent need area a's pi.tool v2) and adding the scenarios marked "new" to its C# port (Compat/CompatScenarios.cs for sessions). The upstream-sessions manifest lists the fields to normalize; v1.2.0 adds durations of nested calls, code mode's wall time, clock and seed.

The new scenarios add events.json (agent events, snapshot first) and observed.json (what calls returned or rejected with). compat.reverse runs verify-reverse.mjs --commit 06a466935536f8c9bcacb2d5efc0fc021be1bdff against this set.

scenarios.name: chat
scenarios.description: One input answered: tagged and untagged prompt sections, an offered tool, a request ID.

scenarios.name: tool-interrupted
scenarios.description: A call to an unsafe (not replay-safe) tool, closed while the tool runs after writing output and details: the file holds the execute checkpoint. Resumed: the call settles as interrupted with its durable partial output, then the model answers.

scenarios.name: follow-up
scenarios.description: An input whose generation is in flight and a follow-up queued behind it, closed while the model is still answering. Resumed: the generation reruns and answers, then the queued follow-up runs.

scenarios.name: compaction
scenarios.description: Three turns, a manual compaction placed at once while idle, then one more turn over the compacted context.

scenarios.name: subagent
scenarios.description: A foreground subagent tool (upstream example 22): the call creates a child conversation its task owns, runs one input there, and returns the child's answer to the parent, which answers.

scenarios.name: fork
scenarios.description: Two turns, an ownerless fork at the first answer, and a turn in the fork.

scenarios.name: task-graph
scenarios.description: A conversation-owned task that creates a conversation it owns and a child task it owns; the child creates a grandchild task it owns and waits for it; each waits (allSettled) and completes once its owned work is done.

scenarios.name: nested-tools
scenarios.description: A model-issued tool makes nested calls (harness-nested-tools.test.ts, harness-callers.test.ts): two parallel calls of a tools-only echo (one under an explicit key), a schema tool, a missing tool and invalid arguments; each nested call is its own pi.tool task owned by the caller with a pi.tool.nested document, and the caller returns what it received to the model.

scenarios.name: structured-output
scenarios.description: Structured tool output (harness-structured-output.test.ts): model-issued calls of a schema tool (its value stays out of the transcript) and of one whose value breaks its schema (the call stands, the host gets a report); then nested calls of an image tool, an error result without a schema, the broken schema tool, a schema tool's error result keeping its value, and a valid one.

scenarios.name: deferred-tool-search
scenarios.description: Deferred tools and tool_search (tool-search.test.ts): two deferred tools stay out of the request until tool_search loads the best match, which pi.agent records in modelTools.add and a pi.system entry appends; the model then calls it.

scenarios.name: codemode
scenarios.description: Durable code mode (codemode.test.ts): a codemode script calls echo, then the replay-safe hold, then echo, each a nested call journaled before delivery; closed while hold runs. Resumed: the script replays from its journal without running the finished echo again, hold reruns, and the script finishes; the model answers.

scenarios.name: read-image
scenarios.description: read returns images (tools-images.test.ts), without an image processor: a 1x1 PNG within the limits comes back as one image block with an info diagnostic; a BMP, which needs converting, is an unsupported_image error result.

scenarios.name: input-entries
scenarios.description: Input entries (harness-input-entries.test.ts): an idle input placed as a chat.mention entry carrying its data, with the content as its user message; then an input whose generation is in flight, with a steer (p2.input, no data) and a follow-up (chat.mention) queued in pi.inbox with their entries; closed. Resumed: the generation reruns, then the queued inputs are placed as their entries.

scenarios.name: display-only-write
scenarios.description: Display-only writes while busy (harness-input-entries.test.ts, #10407): with a generation in flight and a follow-up queued, a write of only kind and data is appended and settled done at once, while writes with a model message or edits queue; once a reset is queued, a display-only write waits behind it. The answer, the reset, and the follow-up then run in order.

scenarios.name: compaction-failure
scenarios.description: Compaction failure (harness-compaction.test.ts): three turns, then a turn whose background threshold compaction fails (pi.live.compactionFailure, compaction_end with error); then a turn over the blocking threshold whose compaction fails too, so the run fails with model_error "Compaction failed: ..." without sending its request.

scenarios.name: session-failed
scenarios.description: Storage failure closes the Session (harness-storage-failure.test.ts): one input answered, then the storage fails the next commit; the call that hit it rejects with the storage error, later calls with SessionFailed (cause: that error), the event stream ends with session_failed and Harness.closed settles { reason: "failed" }. The files hold what was committed before.

scenarios.name: nested-tools-restart
scenarios.description: Nested calls across a restart (harness-nested-tools-restart.test.ts): a replay-unsafe caller makes two nested calls, a replay-safe one that publishes output and details and runs, and one a beforeTool hook holds before intent; closed. Resumed: both are abandoned (abandonOnRestart, abortReason "restart") before they run again, ending interrupted and abandoned, and the caller settles with an error result; the model answers.

scenarios.name: abandon-on-restart
scenarios.description: TaskOptions.abandonOnRestart (harness-nested-tools-restart.test.ts): a replay-unsafe tool creates a child task it owns with api.createTask() and awaits it in memory; closed while the child runs. Resumed: the child is marked with abortReason "restart" and its abort handler ends it aborted before any phase runs again; the tool call ends interrupted and the model answers.

scenarios.name: wait-cycle
scenarios.description: Wait-cycle rejection (harness-structured.test.ts, #10411): conversation-owned task a waits on b; then b commits a wait on a, which closes the cycle a -> b -> a: runtime.commit() rejects it naming the cycle, b ends faulted, and a resumes and completes.
